request: Test the current common-end-rim platen XY model using standard full-integration HEX8; reuse frozen shell and HEX27 results
mass: positive row-sum lumping with exact projected affine inertia
motion: quintic smoothstep, zero undeformed initial state, identical physical time in both solvers
contact_selection: all actual midsurface shell nodes at initial z=0 orL; includes D tangency nodes; same locations in both solvers
jax_contact: own occupied cut-face reference weights, nearest end-node aggregation, own Q2 interpolation; area conserved per end
abaqus_contact: node-based zero contact thickness, Hard automatic penalty; S3R section thickness remains0.5mm and five section integration points
budget_rule: Each geometry one physical path, no parameter retries. Separate300s preparation +2400s JAX including build/compile/stability checks; preserve partial paths on failure/budget.

metrics.RMS_normalizer: own new Abaqus loading maximum absolute upper-platen force; same for global and window RMS
metrics.work: integral of upper-platen compressive force over platen travel; own new Abaqus work denominator
metrics.hold_mean_denominator: own new Abaqus time-mean upper-platen force

peak_rules.primary: Raw global maximum upper-platen compressive force in actual loading window; report force, engineering compression and time
peak_rules.location_difference: JAX minus new Abaqus in compression percentage points; report raw sample spacing
peak_rules.diagnostic_smoothing: Centered moving mean on fixed 1001-point compression grid: width25 samples (~0.5 percentage points); no time warping
peak_rules.first_prominent_peak: On smoothed curve, scipy find_peaks prominence >=10% of its own full-loading absolute peak and distance>=25 samples; list all qualifying peaks, compare first if both have one
peak_rules.endpoint_rule: If global maximum is at end or no qualifying interior peak, mark no captured interior peak rather than claim a buckling peak
peak_rules.incomplete_rule: Compare common achieved window only; no full20 acceptance, no unseen peak extrapolation

stop_policy: No discrepancy/KE-only early stop. Stop on solver error, nonfinite state, nonpositive required actualJ, irrecoverable timestep or budget; preserve incomplete path honestly.
interpretation: Practical HEX8/8QP/row-sum versus HEX27/27QP/HRZ package comparison, not isolated interpolation-order causality
implementation: Same r51 mechanics / r52 bounded runners and preparation; new geometry/Gauss caches and data-only adapters
authorization: User requested HEX8 testing of diverse28/02/04/05 under latest loading, JAX only
